reason: No curated real-world subsidence ground-truth inventory is available for independent validation of the Stage 2.5 subsidence head. USGS landslide featurestacks mask/omit subsidence; UGLC Africa staging is empty; Lagos InSAR is documented/registry-only and not cached as label.tif; Abeokuta TMI and Lagos geophysics are features only.
inventory_notes: USGS National Landslide Inventories on disk are landslide-only (CONUS); not Nigeria subsidence GT.
Lagos InSAR (Ohenhen & Shirzaei) appears in ingestion registry/docs as benchmark-only — not downloaded for Stage 2.5 labels.
Borehole/groundwater/field subsidence inventories: absent on disk.

ground_truth_schema.description: Inventory of observed subsidence positives and validated non-subsidence controls. Synthetic or model-derived scores must never be entered as observations.
forbidden: Model susceptibility scores presented as observations
Synthetic Stage 2.5 training labels as real-world ground truth
TMI or magnetic anomalies as subsidence occurrences

minimum_for_metrics.note: Below these floors, metrics may be reported only as exploratory with an explicit underpowered flag — never as scientific validation.

authoritative_source_examples.name: National geological survey subsidence / sinkhole inventories
authoritative_source_examples.notes: Prefer agency-published GIS with CRS and metadata

authoritative_source_examples.name: Peer-reviewed InSAR deformation studies with validated hotspots
authoritative_source_examples.notes: Deformation ≠ confirmed subsidence hazard class without review

authoritative_source_examples.name: Geotechnical / borehole campaigns with documented settlement
authoritative_source_examples.notes: Licensing and spatial coverage must be recorded

interpretation_rules: Susceptibility scores are relative rankings, not calibrated probabilities.
An Abeokuta score near 58% must not be read as a 58% probability of subsidence.
Synthetic/bootstrap training labels are not scientific ground truth.
required_before_validation: EPSG-declared observed subsidence positives with provenance
Validated non-subsidence controls in the same geographic domain
